# Security policy

Applies to every repository in this organisation.

**Do not open a public issue for a vulnerability.**

Use GitHub private reporting (**Security → Report a vulnerability**) or email `security@flowky.ai`.

First response within 3 working days; assessment within 10. We credit reporters in the advisory unless they prefer otherwise. Good-faith research under this policy will not be pursued — do not access data that is not yours, do not degrade the service, and give us a window before publishing.

FlowKy is bring-your-own-key. Provider credentials stay in the user's editor and no inference request passes through our servers. If any part of the product appears to send a key anywhere, that is a vulnerability.
